notes.title: Cloud saves and empty tree slots
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here is a small update that adds [b]cloud saves[/b] as well as an input (C on keyboard, west button on gamepad) that shows [b]empty tree slots[/b].
On top of that there is a few bug fixes including the [b]ghost tree bug[/b].

notes.title: Donation DLC
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I just set up a donation DLC for those who want to support me in making more update for this game as well as new projects.
Note that the DLC has no content outside of a wallpaper.

Also I just pushed a new build with a fix for the menu on ultra wide screens.

notes.title: Infinoki fix
notes.content:
This fixes enemies stopping to spawn around round 50 while playing Infinoki, making it actually endless.
Have fun!

notes.title: Fixes, improvements and achievements!
notes.content:
Hello!
First of all, thanks a lot to all of you who played the game!
Secondly, I know there has been a lot of issues with the game since launch and I finally took the needed time to fix those, here is the log:

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed the Tauroki crash
- Fixed the missing buyables for the Gardener
- Fixed the random crash once you have a lot of bullets
- Fixed a few minor bugs

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
- Reduced the amount of bullets to improve performance (you'll still lag in the latest levels ngl)

[h3]Content[/h3]
- A few achievements!

Have fun!
